Route Database
Upload all .rtz files once — SunRoute uses them automatically every month
How it works
1. Upload all 340 RTZ files once using the button above
2. SunRoute reads waypoints and stores them in your browser
3. Every month: upload itinerary → Generate → done
4. Position on sea days calculated via exact route waypoints + auto STM
STM is calculated automatically from departure/arrival times in the itinerary.
